title: AI Agent平台化与基础设施升级主导云计算演进，资本密集投向AI初创企业
core_insight: 云计算厂商加速AI Agent平台化布局，基础设施向AI原生架构演进，同时OpenAI创纪录融资凸显AI投资热度与地缘政治风险并存

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出Aurora PostgreSQL秒级Serverless数据库创建，Google Cloud优化GKE工作负载扩展性能，Cloudflare展示Kubernetes运维优化，云原生技术持续成熟 Google Cloud Spanner多模型数据库支持AI代理时代数据统一处理，微软Azure将Agentic AI集成到SQL数据库，Cloudflare推出可编程DDoS防护 Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Spanner's multi-model advantage for the era of agentic AI Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate Uplevel your workload scaling performance with GKE active buffer A one-line Kubernetes fix that saved 600 hours a year Introducing Programmable Flow Protection: custom DDoS mitigation logic for Magic Transit customers Powering the agents: Workers AI now runs large models, starting with Kimi K2.5 DeerFlow 2.0 开源升级：依托 Harness，让 Agent 不再"半途而废"
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出S3账户区域命名空间简化存储管理，Cloudflare发布Gen13服务器实现边缘计算性能翻倍并扩展Regional Services Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器，从缓存优先转向核心数优先架构；AWS与NVIDIA合作强化AI算力基础设施 Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet Introducing account regional namespaces for Amazon S3 general purpose buckets Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more How AI-powered tools are driving the next wave of sustainable infrastructure and reporting
dimension_texts.application: 微软将AI应用于核能行业，Vail Resorts构建AI滑雪助手，火山引擎推出短剧生产Agent，AI向能源、旅游、内容创作等垂直行业深度渗透 Salesforce展示40% IT支持案例由AI代理处理，微软推出Agentic端到端现代化解决方案，企业AI应用进入规模化阶段 How Salesforce Built, Tested, and Scaled Our IT Support Agents Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future How Vail Resorts built an AI assistant to automate personalized recommendations 接入Seedance 2.0，短剧生产Agent「火山剧创」正式邀测 从"单兵作战"到团队协作：Coding Plan + Agents 团队重构 AI 开发范式 How ID.me Scaled to 160M Users While Reducing Operational Risk
dimension_texts.capital: AI初创公司估值持续攀升，OpenAI完成1220亿美元创纪录融资，Y Combinator批次中多家公司估值达4000万美元 OpenAI估值达8520亿美元，创私有公司融资纪录；Strella完成1400万美元A轮融资 Amazon、NVIDIA、软银领投OpenAI融资，微软Copilot扩展应用构建能力，大厂积极布局AI生态 OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise It's not your imagination: AI seed startups are commanding higher valuations Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M Microsoft's Copilot can now build apps and automate your job — here's how it works
